recipes.name: Cocojito (Frozen Mojito)
ingredients_raw: 7 fluid ounces sweetened cream of coconut (such as Coco Lopez®)
2.5 (1.5 fluid ounce) jiggers white rum (such as Bacardi®)

steps.text: Place ice, cream of coconut, rum, 2½ limes, and 5 mint sprigs in a blender; blend until smooth. Pour into 2 glasses, garnish with mint sprigs and lime wedges.

raw_recipe.headline: Cocojito (Frozen Mojito)
raw_recipe.description: This cocojito (frozen mojito) recipe teaches you how to make a yummy frozen coconut drink in a blender with ice, limes, cream of coconut, rum, and mint.

review.reviewBody: Hubby and I really liked this. The coconut flavor was faint. Next time I'll remove the stems from the mint sprigs and just add the leaves. Be sure to remove all the white pithe from the limes so your drinks won't be bitter.
This is so good! Used fresh mint from my garden and Malibu coconut rum and fresh limes, along with the coconut milk. Wonderful! Kicked it up a notch on the run and lime.

Everyone seemed to like it. As I was making both virgin and alcoholic versions out of the same blender pitcher, I excluded the coconut water and spiced rum from the blender mix. Instead I simply added the coconut water or alcohol to each person’s glass at the end with a stir afterwards. The second time I made it was with coconut tequila which added more flavor (with less calories than rum as well) which seemed much better. I also used much less lime juice to keep the focus on the coconut flavor.

I loved this recipe and I am sure it is even more great with the proper ingredients, however, I did not have all the ingredients so I tweeked it a little.....I used 4 cups of ice, 1/3 cup frozen limeade concentrate,7 ounces Cream of Coconut, 3 1/2 oz. coconut rum, 1/3 cup Creme de Mint......it was delicious..............

We used the version that appeared in the most recent Allrecipes magazine. We cut that recipe in half for 2 since it said it served 4; however, to have a taller glass, you had to make the amount for 4 anyway. The first time around, we used all ingredients in the amount stated; the second time, we cut the mint leaves amount in half. We used fresh mint from our garden, which was nice. We enjoyed these and will make them again in the summertime.

I thought it was a great concept but lacked flavor other then lime... Recipe says white rum but a spiced or coconut rum is a must(I haven't tried yet). There is no sweetness whatsoever with the coconut cream alone. I might even throw in some shredded coconut for the second batch. One can of cream makes 4 servings. Also I will pour the rum generously:)
Very refreshing on a hot summers day though the flavor of the coconut was almost non-existent. Added Malibu Rum the second time and that was the missing element! Thanks AngS for the submission!

This is yummy. Added a bit more of the coconut to it, and since I noticed one reviewer mentioned the Wray & Nephew white rum...I remembered a bottle of this "moonshine" like rum I brought home from Jamaica, mon! I put some in....be careful with this over-proofed white rum if ya' use it. Hard to find here, though...I've only seen it in Jamaica. It's what they put in those wicked good rum punch drinks! Have fun! ;-) Thanks for the reminder, blacksnapper!!!

This was fantastic! I had to make a virgin one because I was pregnant, but still so good! Didn't change a thing. If you don't like pulpy, I would recommend substituting the limes for frozen limeade or lime juice. I didn't mind it at all. Will definitely be making this again!
This was really refreshing, the only detracting factor was it wasn't coconutty enough if that makes sense, I added a couple of jiggers of Malibu and that did it
On god, this is the most vile drink concoction I've ever had the displeasure of tasting. I've had day old flat beer more palatable than this.
this was ok, but i found it difficult to prepare, especially since i only have a magic bullet. it wasn't good enough to want to make it a regular but it was a nice change
Served these for book club and they went so fast! Super duper yummy on a hot summer day!
Only use Coco Lopez & Wray & Nephew white rum!
